curatedMovie.curiosityHook: How close are the makers of a disturbing tape when a film student’s thesis on audiovisual violence takes a horrifying turn?
curatedMovie.description: While researching audiovisual violence for her thesis, film student Ángela uncovers a real snuff tape of a murdered former classmate—and realizes the perpetrators are operating right inside her university.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Grim, suspenseful, and intensely demanding, best suited for focused, solitary late-night viewing.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Alejandro Amenábar turns an academic inquiry into a claustrophobic, nerve-shredding thriller about the terrifying proximity of real-world violence.
